steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't move. Hide fast. They're here.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Head inside. In. Right, don't make a peep!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Alright, alright, sir, don't break your bones knocking.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Thanks for keeping us safe. Is everything okay?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Orders from Lord Barth! Searching for a suspect!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (Bro, Filon, what's the deal? What's the 'sir' for...)

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: (Gotta put up the act in front of other people, right, Sir Raz?)

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Searching for a suspect?! Absolutely, search by all means!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: But I can tell you there's no suspects in here, sir! We're all good people, I want you to see that!
(Pffheehee.)
(The cupboard makes a rocking sound.)

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: What was that noise?

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Is there anyone else in your house?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: N—No. Do you see anyone else? I don't...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Maybe you heard wrong, sir?

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Did I? But...

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Fine. Look at the size of this place. We'd know if someone was here.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: And I didn't hear anything. You're on edge.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Alright... if you say so.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Sirs, are you here for...

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: This has nothing to do with you. We're done here.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Remember to immediately report any tips to the search team!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Yeah, I will, I will.
Yeesh, are they finally gone?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey, stay in there!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Keep it down, they're still close...
It's cool, it's cool, Filon, bro. C'mon, unclench those cheeks.
Raz must've heard me a moment ago, didn't he? I mean, he held it in, and he's not gonna turn back to bust me now.
Relax, relax.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I mean, he probably wants to let you go, but the guys behind him might be a different story.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: You're the only woman I've ever met who'd straight-up bomb some old noble's vault, not to mention the part where you drove out throwing the guy's treasure all over the place...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Seriously, Catapult, can you guess how much you're worth right now?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, I bet it can't be as much as all that treasure I left you~

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Heh, you got me there.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Honestly, though, where do you get the guts to do this stuff?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: That was all his best stuff in that safe, y'know! Hah, he's lost his mind. If he catches you for real, he'll be mad enough to peel you like a yucca!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fly in, go boom, fly out. I've gotta do this nickname you all give me a little justice, right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You can only take so much before your back breaks, you know? I'm at my limit with that old-ass... It's not about guts. I was practically forced to do that.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm good now, see. I'm refreshed, and everyone gets a little something nice out of it. Peace and love for all, right?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Forced, my ass. Some people wouldn't hit back if their lives depended on it.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: *sigh*. I'm gonna be honest, Arleta.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, why so formal? Just gonna wave my real name like that, huh.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I'm being real with you. I still think... there's nothing in this for you.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Like, what does it get you? 'cause your gold, jewelry, bills... you haven't held onto a single thing, you threw it all over town.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: What's your plan?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's in for me? Heh, c'mon... does everything I do need some kinda paycheck?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: ...*sigh*. That's not what I mean.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I just—look. You're the old geezer's private army, and he has your share of the pot to give. The tax levy doesn't even come round to you, and if you wanted, you could top up by skimming off all the dues.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: When have I ever pocketed your money?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: You haven't! If you did, you wouldn't be the first, and I would've shoved you out there.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: That's what I'm getting at, at any rate. You live an alright life. You're a far cry from all of us, when we've got days we pay the tax and can't eat afterwards...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: What are you actually thinking, Arleta?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: If I just said I was done with that old fart, no other ideas going on, would you believe me?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Didn't think so.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Okay then, I need a minute. Lemme come up with some reason for you, ha.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey... I'm trying to be as straight as possible here. I don't know, can't you be a little serious?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Bleeugh—you know me, Filon. It's the way I am.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fine. No more jokes.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I should be outta here soon, anyway. No good sticking around yours forever. Can't let this spiral out, or they'll make hell for you too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: If I jump now, maybe I can rustle my way into a merchant caravan heading out of town.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Did you plan this out beforehand?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, I don't actually wanna get flayed by the old guy either.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: See you later, then...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Pass it on to all the people, if anyone else decides to squeeze their lives out, another explosion as coincidental as that vault might just be on the table.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Never, ever, ever sit there and wait for death like that again.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (This van's a cramped fit... I can't stretch my legs straight.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (What's this thing even carrying? It's got a smell, alright... good thing I don't get carsick.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Ups to my luck, though. Two checkpoints down easy.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Good thing I already scoped how the caravan likes to go. It's the perfect ride to hitch.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (As long as this holds, we just need to cross that bridge, and I should be on my way outta this dump.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Once I'm clear, then next, I'll head to... to...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Where? Shoot, I have no idea.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (*yawn* I'm a little sleepy...)

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: ...over there... ...nothing...

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: ...still haven't found them?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Huh? Why is the search team out here?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (He really doesn't wanna give up the chase, huh? C'mon, guy, you're being way too clingy!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Let's take a look...)

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Sirs, what—what are you looking for?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: We're searching for a suspect. Cooperate with us, please.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Raz, we've checked over there! We found nothing suspicious!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Alright, you can pass now.

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Ugh, finally, on our way.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Phew, I'm wiped. Do we have to keep on searching each one like this?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: That's the old man's orders.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: But how much longer do we have to search? We've been going door to door without a break since morning, and now we have to head out all this way.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: If it wasn't for the bounty, I would've given up a while ago.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Weren't you clapping and cheering when you heard someone blew the man's vault out?

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Of course I was!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: It was his private hoard, and now it's in the hands of all the poor common folk! I mean, mwah, who wouldn't give a story like that a thumbs up? Too perfect even for a Columbian movie!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: So you...

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: That's that, this is this. None of the money made it into my hands.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Besides, who'd be on hard times with that reward? The miser's being generous for once!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Haha! Looks like I really do have a good price tag.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (No chance of getting over now, seeing how this all panned out. Even if I hide in a box, they could find me sooner or later...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Gotta do it. Times like these, your only choice is—)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Hup!)

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Ergh! My ass!

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Oof, I'm not hurt... no, wait, where's my wallet? Did someone just steal my wallet?!

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Thief... there's a thief! Catch the thief!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Quit the racket! What happened?

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Knight, sir...! Th—Th—There's a thief!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (And one more for the road...!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Check me out!)

steps.name: Passing Merchant
steps.text: Waagh! Wh—What the hell?

steps.name: Passing Traveler
steps.text: Yeek! Sir Knight, some bastard just felt me... Hey, you were right there! Was it you?!

steps.name: Innocent Passerby
steps.text: Eh? I didn't do it... hey, what are you hitting me for?! Seriously, it wasn't me!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Settle down, please, settle down!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: All of you, calm down... don't get hysterical!

steps.name: Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Where's my wallet?!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Back up, everyone! Our search here isn't over yet... ugh!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Who threw that stone?!

steps.name: Passing Traveler
steps.text: I can't take it anymore! Tell me, how much longer am I going to be stuck here?

steps.name: Passing Traveler
steps.text: I've gotten official passage! I request to be let through here immediately!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Hold on, this is by Lord Barth's command—

steps.name: Innocent Passerby
steps.text: He's just a cruddy knight noble with a hunk of land. Who does he think he is?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Hahaha!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Mm-hm, and there's my moment.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Finally, out of there.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Apologies, Mister, I'll toss your wallet in your van. And you over there, Miss, truly very sorry, I'll let you sock me sometime...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But sorry's all I can give right now!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: See ya, everybody~
You're better off apologizing to their faces than doing it out here to the trees.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Stir chaos, hide in the crowd and slip out of the mess. You almost fooled me.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, hey, it's you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Still got caught, huh? That's not good.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I would've gotten away with it too, if it weren't for your sharp eyes, Raz.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Speaking of, when'd you put all this gear on? You look pretty slick, really like a capital-K Knight. May as well enroll for knighthood sometime, right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The old fart's always been wanting to raise up a Knightclub.
This road... should take me to my destination, if I'm not mistaken.
Hm?
Oh? What's that up there...?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nothing else to say?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Have a care, huh? I'm gonna look real long-winded if it's just me talking, y'know~

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What, you're not here to cuff me and take me back? If you don't do anything, I'm gonna get away, alright? I'm warning you.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: If I was going to bring you in, I would've busted you back at Filon's.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: If I actually did that... chances are Lord Barth would give you a public hanging for real.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: True that, hahaha. Old guy's gotta be blowing his top!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So why'd you chase me out here anyway? Did you wanna give me a ride?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...Whuh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Raz. Raz, bro.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Any way you slice it, the old guy's got all hands out for me. I'm wanted by name... You're deserting, here!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: And you get to talk?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Who slinked off to hit up the streets and go drinking, back when we were on patrol together—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Stoppit, stoppit, let's not reopen old wounds. Bad.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: I came to ask you, why—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why let go of the good days, and risk it all on this?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Man, it's not healthy to be stale like this~ Why's everyone ask this one question?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And if I confess it was just 'cause I was sick of the old guy, you don't even believe me!

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Guh?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: It's a majorly convincing reason, knowing you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are you commending me, or dunking on me... Filon sure didn't believe me one bit.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whatever. We're way past that, now. Let me be real with you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Under the geezer, as long as we do what we're told, we get everything taken care of, and we get a little allowance. And sure, maybe a whole lot consider those fine days to live.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But I just couldn't stand it anymore. Everything that happens everywhere pisses you off. That life grosses me out, down to the core.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But I can't say that in front of the people in that town. I can't drop those words.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I've never gone hungry. How do I have the right to tell people without a meal to eat that I think my life sucks?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: So you did it for all the civvies who couldn't pay taxes...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeuch, don't make me out like some kind of beacon of righteousness. I'm not THAT good-hearted.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I wasn't counting on doing something for anyone else's sakes. Blowing that geezer's vault open, dumping everything in there everywhere, that was all just me channeling my revenge.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Simple as that~
Oh, my...
She's a surprisingly clear-minded girl.
But still, not quite that cautious...

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Raz—!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Oh, crap, they're coming this way! Hide somewhere, quick!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Easy for you to say... there's nowhere to hide here, is there?!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Raz? What are you doing... are you talking to somebody?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Crap, I can't make it!)
Excuse me, sorry for that. I was occupying this kind gentleman's time.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (—Who?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (She walked out from behind... was she seriously behind me the whole time?!)

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Hm? Who is it?

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: You're... wait, it can't be, i—it's you?!
Pardon me. Please, don't be so nervous. I'm just a traveler passing through.
I was asking this gentleman the way just now.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Huh... is that right?

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Uh... yeah, that's right.

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: Um, forgive me, but are you... by any chance, the Candle Knight?
Ah. That is indeed my title.

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: The Candle Knight?! THE renowned Knight from Leithanien... I've seen a whole bunch of your matches!

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: I never expected to meet someone as famous as you here! C... Could you, um, sign—sign this for me, Miss Knight?
I appreciate your praise. If just my signature suffices, I would be delighted.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (This lady's totally distracting everyone!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Just who...)
(Shh.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Is she winking at me...?!)
This doesn't seem too well a place for conversation. If you don't mind, shall we talk as we go?
I've been wanting to pay a visit to the good Lord of this place, as it turns out... so could I trouble you all to show me the way?

steps.name: Search Team Member
steps.text: Of course... of course!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (She led them off for real... Did she—save me?)

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (Catapult.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (What?)

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (To be honest, I didn't have any other real reason to come find you.)

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (I just wanted to tell you this, personally... I don't have your courage, but I admire you.)

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (This little town's too little. Maybe this whole place confines you, in a way.)

steps.name: Patrolling Knight
steps.text: (Seize the moment. Go on.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ahh...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What a nightmare. Here I was banking on having all my bills settled, and I could start my new life free as the wind.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: If I think about it, I've racked up new favors along the way now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nyeaah...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, well~ I've got a few decent bros in my old haunt I can think back on, and that's not a bad feeling~

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And that Candle Knight lady. What a serious weirdo... but she helped me out big time, so consider my 100% fan loyalty as my payment!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I guess this really is goodbye... everyone.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: See you again...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright, time to really think about it now. Where should I be off to next, I wonder~

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, let's leave Kazimierz for starters, and go see what the world beyond is like!
